name: Intraday calm-window drift — compressed-band session (30m)
rationale: ECONOMIC MECHANISM (the intraday calm-window drift at 30m, reading calm through band compression bb_width instead of ATR — a distinct low-vol gauge, and a wider bar to cut fee drag): crypto realized vol has a persistent, partly deterministic intraday shape (session overlaps + funding-settlement clock); GARCH 2025 explains <=15% of variance but the calm windows are exploitable. We drift-long in the calm session windows where fee drag is survivable and avoid the high-vol windows. Entry (long): bb_width below a fitted ceiling (bands compressed -> calm window) AND vol_realized below a fitted ceiling (realized confirms calm) AND ret_Nd modestly negative (buying a small dip inside the calm, not chasing). The edge survives because most systematic flow ignores intraday seasonality — it's un-glamorous and small per trade. Realized features only (no DVOL) -> dodges the 148-point data wall. Exit: bb_width crosses up (compression releasing -> a high-vol window opening) or stop/TP/time. DISCONFIRMER 1: if removing the session/hour conditioning (a plain compressed-band calm reversion) matches the deflated Sharpe, the intraday-clock claim is unsupported and this is a generic squeeze-reversion. DISCONFIRMER 2: <=15% predictable variance -> if per-trade net edge doesn't clear ~20bps at 30m it's fee-eaten. DISCONFIRMER 3: if excluding CPI/FOMC dates kills it, it's event-risk masquerading as seasonality. DISCONFIRMER 4: if bb_width-ceiling and vol_realized-ceiling co-fire >80% they are one gauge -> drop one.
catalyst: a compressed-band calm session window where small-dip drift is cleanest
